battle.name: 第一次蘇丹內戰
battle.brief: 第一次蘇丹內戰於1955年8月爆發，政府軍與南方叛軍在蘇丹南部及中部展開激烈交火。衝突期間，蘇丹政府軍部署了美國製造的M3斯圖亞特輕型坦克，該坦克於1941年正式服役，具備良好機動性與火力支援。

kit.name: M3 斯圖亞特輕型坦克
kit.history: M3 Stuart為二戰期間廣泛使用的輕型坦克，具備高速機動與可靠火力，主要用於偵察、快速突破及支援步兵，是美國裝甲兵力的骨幹之一。

countries: 本場戰爭的主場在英屬蘇丹南部的赤道區、上尼羅區與巴赫爾・加扎爾省。政府軍的主要南部樞紐是白尼羅河上的朱巴，往北可銜接喀土穆；托里特位於尼羅河上游並接近烏干達邊境，耶伊在西側，衣羅爾則通向東部。蘇丹於1956年1月1日獨立後，喀土穆政府與阿尼亞（Anyanya）成為主要交戰方。英國在最初數月進行直接軍事干預，之後隨獨立及撤離逐步退出統治角色；烏干達成為阿尼亞越境整補與重新進入蘇丹的基地，衣索比亞則是談判接觸及最終協議的簽署地。戰區沒有固定而連續的戰線 government軍據點與阿尼亞巡邏區之間的界線隨控制情形反覆移動。
countriesEn: The main theatre of the war lay in the Equatoria, Upper Nile, and Bahr al Ghazal regions of southern Anglo-Egyptian Sudan. The principal government military hub in the south was Juba on the White Nile, with a route northward to Khartoum. Torit stood farther up the Nile near the Ugandan border, Yei lay to the west, and Yirol provided a corridor toward the east. After Sudan became independent on 1 January 1956, the government in Khartoum and the Anyanya became the principal opposing parties. Britain intervened directly during the first months, then gradually withdrew from its governing role as independence and departure proceeded. Uganda became the principal base across which the Anyanya were supplied and from which they re-entered Sudan, while Ethiopia served as a site for diplomatic contact and the final agreement. There was no continuous fixed front; the boundary between government strongpoints and Anyanya patrol zones shifted with local control.
people: 起義的軍事核心是原赤道軍團（Equatoria Corps）士兵。1955年8月18日，駐紮托里特的赤道軍團因整編及調離命令集體抗命。約瑟夫・拉古是出身赤道軍團的努爾族士官，起義後成為阿尼亞・努爾最具代表性的領袖；約翰・拉塔迪等人則參與早期軍事指揮。最初數月，各駐地起義者尚未形成統一參謀系統，直到1956年後才逐漸建立地方支隊、指揮關係與跨境補給。拉古所領的努爾派長期是實力核心，但到1960年代中期，阿尼亞・努爾與其他南部派別因領導權及對政府談判方式而出現分裂。北方作戰由蘇丹正規軍、警察及政府協調的地方戰鬥隊承擔，政治決策先後經歷數屆內閣，1969年後由總統賈法爾・尼梅里主持。阿貝爾・阿利爾是1972年南部政治安排的主要簽署者，海萊・塞拉西則以衣索比亞元首身分主持促成協議的外交場合。
peopleEn: The military core of the uprising was formed by soldiers of the former Equatoria Corps. On 18 August 1955, the corps garrisoned at Torit mutinied over orders concerning integration and redeployment. Joseph Lagu was a Nuer non-commissioned officer who had served in the Equatoria Corps and became the best-known leader of the Anya Nuer after the revolt. John Latady and others participated in the early military command structure. During the first months, the mutineers at different stations had not yet created a unified staff system. Local detachments, command relationships, and cross-border supply arrangements developed gradually after 1956. Lagu's Nuer faction remained the principal military force for many years, but by the middle of the 1960s the Anya Nuer and other southern factions divided over leadership and approaches to negotiations with the government. On the northern side, operations were conducted by the Sudanese regular army, police, and government-coordinated local combat formations. Political direction passed through several administrations and, after 1969, was led by President Jaafar Nimeiry. Abel Alier was a principal signatory to the southern political settlement of 1972, while Haile Selassie provided the diplomatic setting in which the agreement was concluded.
kits: 1955年時，交戰雙方的共同裝備底層是英軍在蘇丹留下的殖民時期庫存。赤道軍團使用口徑為.303英制彈藥、相當於7.7公厘的Long Lee-Enfield Mk I步槍，該型在1895年即已列裝；輕機槍則是L7 Bren，原始型在1938年投入使用，L7A4於1954年進入英軍服役，各批單位的槍身、彈匣及備件供應並不完全一致。北方常規軍早期仍以同系步槍和輕機槍為主，英系火力配備包括2英吋迫擊炮與QF 25-pounder野戰炮，兩者均在1930年代已列裝，25-pounder使用87.6公厘炮彈。阿尼亞早期彈藥主要來自軍械庫、繳獲及跨境整補，總量有限；作戰小組必須分散攜帶不同批次與不同供應來源的弹药，並靠徒軍、河流小艇和短程公路轉運。政府的較可靠後勤線從朱巴沿托里特公路、朱巴至耶伊公路及尼羅河航線輸送卡車、炮彈與迫擊炮彈，因此道路安全與船期往往比一次攻佔據點更能決定補給成敗。
kitsEn: The common equipment base of both sides in 1955 came largely from British colonial stocks left in Sudan. The Equatoria Corps used the Long Lee-Enfield Mk I rifle chambered in .303-inch, equivalent to 7.7 mm; this model had entered service in 1895. Its light machine gun was the L7 Bren. The original type entered service in 1938, while the L7A4 entered British service in 1954. The bodies, magazines, and spare parts available to individual units were not uniform. The northern regular army continued to rely mainly on related rifles and light machine guns in the early years. Its British-pattern fire support included the 2-inch mortar and QF 25-pounder field gun, both of which had entered service during the 1930s; the 25-pounder fired 87.6 mm ammunition. Early Anyanya ammunition came mainly from military stores, captures, and cross-border resupply, and the total supply was limited. Combat groups had to carry dispersed quantities from different batches and sources, using porters, small river craft, and short road movements. The government's more dependable logistical lines ran from Juba along the roads to Torit and Yei and along the Nile. Trucks, artillery ammunition, and mortar bombs depended on those routes, making road security and shipping schedules more decisive for supply than the temporary capture of a single post.
tactics: 阿尼亞早期以小支部隊作戰，不會把全區兵力集中在一條公路上。典型方式是先派偵察組確認政府哨站、渡口與車隊日程，再由徒步分隊利用樹林、河岸及地形間隙接近，攻擊孤立哨位或短暫封鎖道路；取得武器後立即分散，使政府炮火難以一次命中整個目標。托里特、耶伊與衣羅爾的攻防多屬奪點、撤出及重新打擊，而非長期防守同一塹壕。較成熟的阿尼亞武裝也會以小股兵力牽制政府縱隊，再攻擊其側翼與後方倉庫。政府軍的對策是鞏固據點、保護車隊，沿朱巴至托里特、耶伊或衣羅爾的道路進行縱深清剿，並以炮兵、飛機偵察與轟炸支援地方戰鬥隊封住林帶出口。1964年的政府攻勢顯示，只要交通線與邊境協同，北方可以迫使阿尼亞主力退向烏干達；但政府無法同時守住多處分散哨站，也難以把追擊部隊長久留在雨季後泥濘的河網地區。阿尼亞的優勢是後勤線短、轉向快，弱點則是重武器、彈藥及持續控制城市的能力有限。
tacticsEn: The early Anyanya operated in small detachments rather than concentrating all their forces along one road. A typical pattern was to send reconnaissance teams to identify government posts, crossings, and convoy schedules. Infantry then approached on foot through woods, riverbanks, and gaps in the terrain to attack isolated posts or briefly block a road. After obtaining weapons, the detachments dispersed immediately, making it difficult for government artillery to strike the entire force in one engagement. Fighting around Torit, Yei, and Yirol generally consisted of seizing a position, withdrawing, and returning to attack again rather than maintaining one continuous trench line. More developed Anyanya formations also used small forces to pin down government columns before striking their flanks and rear depots. The government's response was to consolidate posts, protect convoys, conduct depth clears along the roads from Juba to Torit, Yei, and Yirol, and use artillery, aerial reconnaissance, and bombing to support local combat formations in closing exits from wooded areas. The government offensive of 1964 demonstrated that, when transport routes and border action were coordinated, the northern army could drive the principal Anyanya force toward Uganda. It could not, however, hold numerous dispersed posts at once or keep pursuit forces permanently in the muddy river regions after the rainy season. Anyanya strength lay in short supply lines and rapid changes of direction; their limitations lay in heavy weapons, ammunition, and the ability to hold towns continuously.
data: 1955年8月18日，駐托里特的赤道軍團首先起義，起義者奪取軍械，周邊駐軍與哨站隨後加入。9月下旬，英方組成的部隊自烏干達沿托里特公路推進，一度恢復對托里特及附近道路的控制，但未能消滅越境後重新集中的阿尼亞主力，英方其後退出直接追擊。1956年6月，阿尼亞武裝由烏干達重新越境，攻入並一度佔領托里特；同年1月1日蘇丹獨立時，戰鬥已跨越殖民政府交接與新國家軍隊組成的界線。此後至1960年代初，政府軍仍掌握朱巴及主要河運節點，阿尼亞則在赤道省大片地區活動，双方先後爭奪耶伊、衣羅爾和通往烏干達的走廊，前線因-counterattack而反覆移動。1950年代後期至1960年代初，政府軍曾沿朱巴至耶伊及朱巴至衣羅爾的公路發動反擊，但未能建立連續而穩定的南部控制。1960年代中期，阿尼亞・努爾與其他派別分裂，武器和指挥關係不再完全統一。1964年，北方發動較大規模攻勢，配合烏干達收緊邊境，使阿尼亞主力退往邊境；其後部分隊伍重新進入蘇丹，但作戰規模較前減小。1969年政權更替後，部分南部軍官脫離政府軍並與阿尼亞合作，使南部問題同時成為軍隊忠誠與國家權力問題。1970年代初，邊境襲擊、零散據點爭奪與談判並行。1972年3月31日，蘇丹政府與阿尼亞主要領袖在亞的斯亞貝巴簽署協議，持續十七年的組織化戰爭至此進入終止階段。
dataEn: On 18 August 1955, the Equatoria Corps garrisoned at Torit mutinied first. The mutineers seized military stores, and surrounding garrisons and posts subsequently joined them. In late September, a British-organized force advanced from Uganda along the Torit road and briefly restored government control of Torit and nearby routes. It failed to destroy the main Anyanya force after the latter regrouped across the border, and British forces then withdrew from direct pursuit. In June 1956, the Anyanya re-entered Sudan from Uganda, attacked Torit, and occupied it for a time. The fighting had already crossed the transition from colonial rule when Sudan became independent on 1 January of that year. From then until the early 1960s, the government retained Juba and the main river-transport nodes, while the Anyanya operated across broad areas of Equatoria. Both sides contested Yei, Yirol, and the corridors toward Uganda, and the front shifted repeatedly as counterattacks were launched. From the late 1950s into the early 1960s, government forces counterattacked along the Juba-Yei and Juba-Yirol roads but did not establish continuous and stable control throughout the south. In the middle of the 1960s, the Anya Nuer and other factions divided, and weapons and command relationships were no longer fully unified. In 1964, the northern government launched a larger offensive that, together with tighter Ugandan restrictions on the border, drove the principal Anyanya force toward Uganda. Some units later re-entered Sudan, but operations were smaller than before. Following the political change of 1969, some southern officers left the government army and cooperated with the Anyanya, making the southern question simultaneously an issue of military loyalty and state power. In the early 1970s, border attacks, fighting around isolated posts, and negotiations proceeded together. On 31 March 1972, the Sudanese government and the principal Anyanya leaders signed an agreement in Addis Ababa, bringing the organized seventeen-year war into its concluding phase.
cause: 直接原因是赤道軍團即將被解散、整編並調離南部地區，起義者反對蘇丹獨立後取消獨立的南部部隊體系。軍令中涉及的部署、指揮關係與晉升安排，使士兵擔心原來由南部軍官形成的指揮網會被北方軍官取代，個人也可能在缺乏選擇的情況下被調往北部。蘇丹獨立並非單純的行政交接；英國長期採取分區統治，使南北軍隊在待遇、訓練及制度地位上形成明顯差異，而新國家的憲政安排又沒有為南部軍事自治及部隊整編提供穩定答案。喀土穆各屆政府把南部控制視為國家安全與軍隊統一問題，拉古等南部軍官則把整編視為指揮權、地方自治及軍團存續問題。1955年的抗命因此不是單純對薪資的不滿，而是由部隊調動、制度不平等、邊際化感受及未確定的安全安排共同造成。英國撤離後，過去由殖民當局隔開的南北矛盾直接進入新國家的軍隊與憲政體系。
causeEn: The immediate cause was the planned dissolution, integration, and redeployment of the Equatoria Corps out of the southern regions. The mutineers opposed the abolition of a separate southern military unit during the transition to Sudan's independence. Deployment, command relationships, and promotion arrangements in the orders raised fears that the southern officer corps would be replaced by northern officers and that individual soldiers could be transferred north without meaningful choice. Independence was not merely an administrative transfer. Britain's long policy of separate regional administration had produced clear differences in service conditions, training, and institutional status, while the constitutional arrangements of the new state did not provide a stable answer concerning southern military autonomy and the integration of southern units. Governments in Khartoum treated control of the south as a question of national security and military unity. Southern officers such as Lagu regarded integration as a dispute over command, regional autonomy, and the survival of the southern corps. The mutiny of 1955 was therefore not simply a complaint about pay. It arose from redeployment, institutional inequality, marginalization, and unsettled security arrangements. After Britain departed, contradictions previously contained by the colonial authority entered the military and constitutional system of the new state directly.
impact: 這場戰爭首先改變了南部控制問題的性質。阿尼亞並非只進行邊境襲擊，而是曾掌握托里特、耶伊、衣羅爾之間的大片地區，使喀土穆無法以連續據點和穩定交通線維持南部軍事存在。長期戰鬥也把南部軍官培養成相對獨立且高度武裝化的政治軍事力量；政府改組時，軍隊是否承認中央命令、區域自治及軍官晉升，常成為直接的政治問題。阿尼亞・努爾及其他派別的分裂削弱了單一指揮，卻沒有消除共同反對政府軍的壓力，使政府難以取得全面而持久的戰場勝利。烏干達是否允許南部武裝使用邊境，直接影響北方能否對其施行軍事、外交及後勤壓力。政府因而在後來同時依靠正規軍、地方戰鬥隊、炮兵、航空力量與邊境協調。這種無法以常規軍永久消滅游擊力量的經驗，使南部區域政府、軍隊整編及中央安全權限的安排成為結束戰爭的制度核心。
impactEn: The war first transformed the question of control in the south. The Anyanya did not merely conduct border raids; at times they controlled large areas linking Torit, Yei, and Yirol. This prevented Khartoum from maintaining a permanent southern military presence through continuous strongpoints and reliable transport lines. Prolonged combat also turned southern officers into a relatively independent and highly armed political-military force. During changes of government, recognition of central orders, regional autonomy, and promotion of southern officers repeatedly became direct political issues. The division between the Anya Nuer and other factions weakened unified command but did not remove their shared pressure against government forces, making it difficult for the government to achieve a complete and lasting battlefield victory. Whether Uganda permitted southern forces to use its territory directly affected northern military, diplomatic, and logistical pressure. The government consequently relied increasingly on regular troops, local combat formations, artillery, aviation, and border coordination. Its inability to eliminate guerrilla forces permanently through conventional operations made the Southern Regional Government, military integration, and central security authority central institutional issues in ending the war.
result: 雙方都沒有取得能永久控制全境的戰場勝利，結束方式是談判與制度讓步。1972年3月31日，總統賈法爾・尼梅里、阿貝爾・阿利爾及阿尼亞領袖約瑟夫・拉古在亞的斯亞貝巴簽署協議，海萊・塞拉西提供外交主持。主要阿尼亞派別接受停火，蘇丹在統一國家框架內設立南部區域政府，賦予其內部行政、地方警察及治安事務的自治理權，國防與外交仍由中央掌握。南部區域政府設於朱巴，阿利爾出任首任區域總理。協議同時要求前戰鬥武裝分階段解除武裝、復員，並吸收到蘇丹軍隊及區域安全單位；執行並未在簽署當日完成，派別與武器整編問題仍需後續處理。就歷史分期而言，阿尼亞作為有組織政治軍事力量所進行的主要戰爭至此結束，其後的政變衝突及1983年開始的另一次蘇丹內戰不應倒算為這場戰爭的延續。
resultEn: Neither side achieved a battlefield victory that allowed permanent control of the entire country. The war ended through negotiation and institutional concessions. On 31 March 1972, President Jaafar Nimeiry, Abel Alier, and Anyanya leader Joseph Lagu signed an agreement in Addis Ababa under the diplomatic sponsorship of Haile Selassie. The principal Anyanya factions accepted a ceasefire. Within a united Sudan, the agreement established a Southern Regional Government with self-government over internal administration, regional police, and security, while defence and foreign affairs remained under central authority. The regional government was based in Juba, with Alier serving as its first regional premier. Former combatants were also required to disarm and demobilize in stages and be absorbed into the Sudanese armed forces and regional security units. Implementation was not completed on the day of signature, and factional and weapons-integration issues required further handling. In historical terms, the principal organized war of the Anyanya ended at that point. Later coup-related conflict and the separate Sudanese civil war that began in 1983 should not be counted backward as a continuation of this war.
